body:
## Problem

The non-releasing rule in `.github/renovate.json` matches only `"matchManagers": ["github-actions", "pre-commit"]`, and the major-prefix rule only `["pre-commit"]`. Renovate's `nvm` manager, which updates `.nvmrc`, matches neither. `.nvmrc` is not in `package.json` `files`, and the workflows read it only through `node-version-file`, so a Node bump there never reaches consumers. Renovate still titles it with the preset default scope `deps`.

## Evidence

- Shared preset `github>ivuorinen/renovate-config` sets `semanticCommitScope: "actions"` only for `matchManagers: ["github-actions"]`, and sets `commitMessagePrefix: "chore(deps)!: "` on every `major` update. Its `chore(actions): ` override for majors covers github-actions only.
- Shared release rules (`@ivuorinen/semantic-release-config` 3.0.0 `index.cjs:11-13`): `chore(deps)` gives a patch, breaking `chore(deps)` gives a major, and `chore(actions)` gives no release.
- Observed: ivuorinen/base-configs#577 and ivuorinen/base-configs-commitlint#196 (branch `renovate/node-26.x`, which changes only `.nvmrc`). Renovate titled both `chore(deps): update node.js (…)`, including force-pushes made after the actions/devDependencies rule landed (#578 / #201). The maintainer renamed both to `chore(actions): …` by hand before merging (PR timeline `renamed` events by the maintainer).

## Impact

Unless someone retitles the PR, every Node minor or patch bump merges as `chore(deps)` and publishes a needless patch release. In config-checker, each release then fans out into Renovate bumps across every @ivuorinen package. A Node major (for example 26 → 28) arrives as `chore(deps)!:` and publishes a **major** release of the package, even though consumers see no change.

## Fix

Add `"nvm"` to both manager lists, and update the first rule's description so it names `.nvmrc` as well:

```json
"matchManagers": ["github-actions", "nvm", "pre-commit"],
…
"matchManagers": ["nvm", "pre-commit"],
"matchUpdateTypes": ["major"],
"commitMessagePrefix": "chore(actions): "
```

The better fix is to make the same change once in the shared `ivuorinen/renovate-config` preset, next to its github-actions major rule, so all nine repos pick it up.

## Resolution
Fixed in the shared preset, ivuorinen/renovate-config#114 (merged as 503bbff): nvm (.nvmrc) and pre-commit updates get the literal prefix "chore(tooling): " and devDependencies/require-dev get "chore(dev-deps): " for every update type, so none carries the global "chore(deps)!: " major marker; "actions" stays reserved for github-actions. @ivuorinen/semantic-release-config releases on the deps scope only, so tooling and dev-deps commits cut no release (checked through commit-analyzer). ivuorinen/config-checker#252 then removed every local scope, prefix and group rule from this repo's .github/renovate.json; only the conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits <10 hold remains.
title: Renovate .nvmrc (nvm manager) updates are titled chore(deps) and release the package

## Problem

dependency-vulnerability through `@semantic-release/npm` → `npm`.

## Evidence

osv-scanner 2.7.0, trivy 0.76.0 `--include-dev-deps` and `yarn npm audit --recursive` agree on origin/main f90320b: pacote 21.5.0 (GHSA-w4pp-8pjf-rmxw, high), tar 7.5.20 (GHSA-r292-9mhp-454m, high), ip-address 10.7.2 (GHSA-rxp7-6hxx-x8q5). The uncommitted WIP stashed as stash@{0} re-resolves the tree and scans clean.

## Impact

The scanners fail on the committed lockfile.

## Fix

Apply the stashed WIP (devDependency bumps, `resolutions` removed) on a branch, `yarn up -R` anything still flagged, confirm osv-scanner exits 0.

## Resolution
fix/audit-2026-10 fb7cf25: devDependencies updated and the four resolutions dropped; osv-scanner 2.7.0 on the new yarn.lock: No issues found (pacote, tar, ip-address gone). Tests, eslint and pre-commit --all-files pass.
title: yarn.lock resolves pacote 21.5.0, tar 7.5.20 and ip-address 10.7.2, all with advisories

body:
## Problem

supply-chain. `.yarnrc.yml` sets no `npmMinimalAgeGate`; the one-day gate in force is Yarn 4's built-in default.

## Evidence

`yarn config --why npmMinimalAgeGate` → `Source: <default>`. opengrep 1.31.0 rule `yarn-missing-minimal-age-gate` fires on `.yarnrc.yml:1`.

## Impact

A Yarn default change would silently remove the install-time guard.

## Fix

Add `npmMinimalAgeGate: 3d`, matching the shared Renovate preset's 3-day `minimumReleaseAge`.

## Resolution
fix/audit-2026-10 92258f2: npmMinimalAgeGate: 3d declared; yarn config --why reports Source .yarnrc.yml, Value 4320. Control: a fresh resolution of a 49h-old version is refused (quarantined); yarn install --immutable still passes.
title: The npm age gate is inherited from Yarn's default instead of being declared

## Problem

misconfiguration. The file's only line is `//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${NPM_TOKEN}`. #251 removed `NPM_TOKEN` from both workflows and the secret was deleted after publishing moved to OIDC trusted publishing.

## Evidence

`.npmrc:1`. `gh secret list -R ivuorinen/config-checker` → `PAT` only. publish.yml:94 comments `No NPM_TOKEN: @semantic-release/npm publishes via OIDC Trusted Publishing`. opengrep rule `npm-missing-minimum-release-age` also fires on this file. `files: ["lib"]` keeps it out of the tarball.

## Impact

Dead auth config that tells a reader a token is still in use, and an empty `_authToken` handed to every npm command run in the repo.

## Fix

Delete `.npmrc`; nothing else in the repo reads it (Yarn uses `.yarnrc.yml`).

## Resolution
fix/audit-2026-10 cfd6e6a: .npmrc removed; no tracked file referenced it; files whitelist already excluded it from the tarball.
title: .npmrc still points npm at the NPM_TOKEN secret that was deleted for OIDC publishing

body:
## Problem

duplicate-dependency. `@semantic-release/commit-analyzer`, `@semantic-release/github`, `@semantic-release/npm` and `@semantic-release/release-notes-generator` are declared next to `semantic-release`, which depends on all four and loads plugins from its own install first.

## Evidence

Manifest: package.json devDependencies lines for the four plugins. Lockfile: each resolves once (13.0.1, 12.0.9, 13.1.5, 14.1.1). Usage: named only in `.releaserc.cjs`. `node_modules/semantic-release/lib/plugins/utils.js:59`: `resolveFrom.silent(basePath, name) || resolveFrom(cwd, name)` with `basePath` = semantic-release's own directory; semantic-release 25's `dependencies` include all four. CI publishes through cycjimmy/semantic-release-action's bundled semantic-release, which never sees this repo's copies. base-configs-semantic-release dropped its separate `@semantic-release/github` pin for this reason (audit-7a6de605).

## Impact

Four extra pins that drift from what semantic-release requests and one more Renovate PR per plugin release.

## Fix

`yarn remove @semantic-release/commit-analyzer @semantic-release/github @semantic-release/npm @semantic-release/release-notes-generator`; keep `semantic-release` (the `semantic-release` script) and `conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits` (the preset).

## Resolution
fix/audit-2026-10 f9272dd: the four plugins removed (user-approved per dependency); semantic-release's loader still resolves all four plus the conventionalcommits preset from node_modules; osv clean; tests and eslint pass.
title: Four @semantic-release plugin devDependencies duplicate what semantic-release already ships

## Problem

dead config. `.yamlignore` is a 0-byte file that no tool reads; yamllint takes ignores from `.yamllint.yml`.

## Evidence

`wc -c .yamlignore` → 0; no tracked file references it; base-configs-commitlint's `.yamllint.yml:4` documents that yamllint does not read it.

## Impact

A file that looks like configuration and does nothing.

## Fix

`git rm .yamlignore`.

## Resolution
fix/audit-2026-10 78f9659: .yamlignore removed; nothing referenced it.
title: The empty .yamlignore file is read by nothing

body:
## Problem

`configChecker` prints every candidate path when `process.env.DEBUG` is truthy. `DEBUG` is the shared switch of the `debug` package (`DEBUG=express:*`, `DEBUG=*`), and the README does not mention that config-checker reads it.

## Evidence

`lib/config-checker.js:22-25`: `if (process.env.DEBUG) { ... console.log(filesWithPath); }`. `rg DEBUG README.md` → no match. Every config package calls `configChecker` from its postinstall, so the dump lands in install output.

## Impact

A developer who sets `DEBUG=*` (or any namespace) to debug an unrelated tool gets an array of dozens of paths from each of seven postinstall scripts in their install log, with nothing explaining where it comes from.

## Fix

Scope the switch to this package, `if (/(^|,)\s*(config-checker|\*)(,|$)/.test(process.env.DEBUG ?? ""))`, matching the `debug` package's namespace convention, and document `DEBUG=config-checker` in README.md.

## Resolution
fix/audit-2026-10 9bab157: DEBUG read as a comma-separated list, printing only for config-checker or *; new tests pin config-checker/*/list = print and express:*/1 = silent; control: the old truthiness check fails them. README documents it.
title: Any DEBUG value turns on config-checker's path dump, and the variable is undocumented

body:
## Problem

The Usage section points at `https://github.com/ivuorinen/base-configs-commitlint/scripts/postinstall.js` and quotes a snippet as coming from that file.

## Evidence

The URL lacks `/blob/main/` and names `postinstall.js`; the file is `scripts/postinstall.cjs`. The quoted snippet (`require("process")`, `checkConfig("commitlint")` with no path, `process.exit(0)`) matches none of the seven current postinstall scripts: commitlint's now wraps the check in `createStarterConfig()` and never calls `process.exit`, and the others pass the project root explicitly (`checkConfig("eslint", cwd)`).

## Impact

The only usage example a reader gets is a dead link and code that omits the INIT_CWD fallback every real caller relies on.

## Fix

Point the example at `https://github.com/ivuorinen/base-configs-eslint/blob/main/scripts/postinstall.cjs` and quote its current check: `const cwd = process.env.INIT_CWD || process.cwd(); const foundConfig = checkConfig("eslint", cwd); ...`.

## Resolution
fix/audit-2026-10 dcd2fb4: example now quotes base-configs-eslint scripts/postinstall.cjs; new link HTTP 200, old link HTTP 404.
title: The README's real-world example links to a path that does not exist and quotes code that is no longer there

## Problem

`.editorconfig` sets `max_line_length = 160` for every file; two files on main exceed it.

## Evidence

editorconfig-checker 4.0.2 on origin/main f90320b:

```text
.github/renovate.json:
  8: line too long (372 instead of 160)
README.md:
  75: line too long (185 instead of 160)
```

## Impact

MegaLinter's EDITORCONFIG linter fails on these files whenever a PR touches them.

## Fix

Write the Renovate `description` as an array of strings (Renovate accepts `string | string[]`, as base-configs' renovate.json already does) and wrap the README paragraph.

## Resolution
fix/audit-2026-10 c7336db: renovate.json description split into an array of strings, README paragraphs wrapped; editorconfig-checker on every tracked file outside docs/audit exits 0.
title: Two tracked files break the repo's own EditorConfig line-length limit

body:
## Problem

eslint.config.mjs and .releaserc.cjs copied @ivuorinen/eslint-config and @ivuorinen/semantic-release-config by hand, with five devDependencies, publish.yml's `extra_plugins` pin and a Renovate <10 hold that existed only to feed the copies.

## Evidence

They were vendored because both packages depend on this one. The copies had drifted (#250: an ecmaVersion pin, and `chore(deps)!` releasing a minor). The release cascade that made the cycle harmful is gone: the shared Renovate preset titles every devDependency update `chore(dev-deps): `, majors included, and the shared release rules cut no release for it.

## Impact

Every change to either shared config needs a matching hand edit here, and a missed one changes how this package is linted or released.

## Fix

Depend on both packages as devDependencies, re-export the ESLint config with lib/ un-ignored, extend the release config from .releaserc.json, and drop extra_plugins, the hold and the devDependencies that only rebuilt the copies.

## Resolution
4c45ad0: @ivuorinen/eslint-config and @ivuorinen/semantic-release-config are devDependencies; eslint.config.mjs re-exports with lib/ un-ignored, .releaserc.json extends; extra_plugins, the <10 hold and five devDependencies removed. --print-config byte-identical for five files; semantic-release's config loader yields the same plugin options as the copy.
title: eslint.config.mjs and .releaserc.cjs are hand-kept copies of the shared configs
